A little while ago there was a discussion post in another sub where the question asked was "If you are rich, what advise do you have?" Someone was trying to gauge how to become richer and what sort of mind set you should have. I posted this response:

"The more luxury you give up, the faster you get there. This includes replacing time spent watching tv and playing games with learning how finances work or how a business works. If you want to be rich constantly ask yourself this question everytime you do something: Am I improving myself for financial success or producing something to contribute to financial success or am I consuming some one elses product and contributing to someone elses success? If the latter part is true and you are not already successful, you are not winning."

Now, I mention in the title "Becoming a producer". Now, when I say this I do not necessarily refer directly to making something to sell or growing something in a farm. If you produce better ways to live, work and play, then you are also a producer. If you are a regular employee and you go to your 9 to 5 job and you are happy there and do not want to start a business for yourself, this is the sort of producing you need to do.

Produce a better person through life style changes and education. Say you are in the 9-5 job category. Instead of playing games one weekend you decide to learn about taxes and finance. You spend time reading the laws, going over ideas on the internet and finding out the things you can claim against tax as a regular worker. You may discover something you've not been putting on your tax and might get some more money back. You might discover a cheaper and more reliable way of finding a good accountant. You might learn how to do your own taxes. In Australia, you can save a good $200-300 if you learn to do your own taxes. For a 9-5 office job with no other major financial assets, you can do your tax very quickly. (at least in Australia, I encourage people from other countries to let me know your situations).

In life there is almost nothing that can be improved with research and education. Any project on my property or house is always discounted or in some cases free. Many people in the building industry often try to get rid of excess goods for free as it saves them the time and cost of disposing it. I constantly get free bricks for my gardens this way. I have worked in the building industry and I spend time at markets and getting to know people who do these things. You too can do these things, instead of just sitting at home watching TV or playing games.

I often say to people who question me when they see me trying to avoid paying for something in full or when I'm negotiating a cheap deal. "Rich people don't stay rich by spending money." I may not be super high end millionaire rich, but warren buffet drove an old Cadillac for most of his early rich years. The goal is to emulate these sort of tactics.
